title: Fix and Print
prompt:
Fix the broken program, then make `program()` print exactly three lines:
`CIEN`
`compiles clean`
`ships on time`
(The program must also compile: it is missing its include, its return statement, and a semicolon.)

tests.name: three exact lines
tests.hint: Print the three lines in order; output must end with a newline (std::endl or '\n').

tests.name: compiles cleanly
tests.hint: The whole program must compile — the missing include, semicolon, and return statement must be repaired.
